# Rulebook

17 rules in 6 topics: 14 agreed, 1 to confirm, 1 deferred, 1 superseded. [1 open question](questions.md). The terms are in the [glossary](glossary.md).

## [Requests and routes](requests.md)

| id | status | rule |
|---|---|---|
| [R4](requests.md#R4) | agreed | A request is for one patient, with a route per lab |
| [R5](requests.md#R5) | agreed | A request ends when its routes have |
| [R6](requests.md#R6) | agreed | A sample stopped anywhere on the route was not reported |

## [Steps and their roll-up](steps.md)

| id | status | rule |
|---|---|---|
| [R1](steps.md#R1) | agreed | A step rolls up from its tasks, one per stage |
| [R2](steps.md#R2) | agreed | The latest stage reached decides failure |
| [R3](steps.md#R3) | agreed | A sample stopped elsewhere counts neither way |

## [Sites and transfers](transfers.md)

| id | status | rule |
|---|---|---|
| [R13](transfers.md#R13) | agreed | A transfer is picked up at its origin and delivered at its destination |
| [R14](transfers.md#R14) | agreed | Next door, samples are walked over |

## [Samples, scans and deviations](samples.md)

| id | status | rule |
|---|---|---|
| [R7](samples.md#R7) | agreed | Every status comes from a scan on the sample |
| [R8](samples.md#R8) | agreed | A deviation holds the step until a person decides |
| [R9](samples.md#R9) | agreed | A tube rejected on receipt fails the step at once |

|---|---|---|
